liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1983-04-26.sbd.miller.97544.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 167 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Miller soundboard improves on earlier versions, removing the drop out at the song's end; Sound quality is on point, and the reviewer loves the opening track; Static during the song originates from the PA system [1][18][24]
- **gd1983-04-26.163360.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1983-04-26.112583.Sennheiser.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording captures the vibe, though the performance felt rushed to the reviewer [20]
- **gd1983-04-26.aud.dillon.28360.sbefail.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the performance as unreal and notes Phil is killing it; Two-generation audience recording is rated as sounding very good; Reviewer identifies this as the best audience source and enjoys the jam sequence [7][16][17][22][23]
- **gd1983-04-26.132784.sbd.healy-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [10]
- **gd1983-04-26.132607.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 159 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [12]. Said about its sound: Track titles are incorrect; track three is actually Me & My Uncle [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-04-26.sbd.miller.97544.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: FOB Sennheiser shotguns transferred to cassette master, then CD, with pitch correction [1]
- **gd1983-04-26.163360.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: Sennheiser 421 source patches a 38-second gap in Space and provides the encore [3]
- **gd1983-04-26.112583.Sennheiser.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones (up front-center) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [6]
- **gd1983-04-26.aud.dillon.28360.sbefail.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by David Dillon; source: Unknown mics > MC [7]. Also: David Dillon transferred his tapes to disk, with a cut removed from Drums [7]
- **gd1983-04-26.132784.sbd.healy-wise.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Soundboard Cassette (Dan Healy)-1st Generation 7 Inch Reel @ 7.5 ips 1/4 Track(Dick L)-Tascam 122MK111 Cassette Deck-Technics 1506 Reel 2… [10]. Also: Reviewer appreciates having this specific lineage source for the show [26]
- **gd1983-04-26.132607.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard(shinid:97544) SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat (48k); Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Adobe Audition… [12]
